description: Defines scheduling context structures and functions for UE scheduling grant parameter selection in 5G NR, including DL and UL contexts, VRB allocation, and retrieval functions for new transmission and retransmission scenarios.

classes.name: dl_sched_context
classes.description: Contains parameters for downlink scheduling, including search space, resource index, MCS, layers, RBs, and pending bytes.

classes.name: ul_sched_context
classes.description: Contains parameters for uplink scheduling, including search space, resource index, VRB limits, RB limits, MCS, RBs, pending bytes, and PUSCH configuration.

methods.name: get_newtx_dl_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended downlink parameters for a new transmission grant.

methods.name: get_retx_dl_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended downlink parameters for a retransmission grant.

methods.name: compute_newtx_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Selects VRBs for a new downlink transmission.

methods.name: compute_retx_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Selects VRBs for a downlink retransmission.

methods.name: get_newtx_ul_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended uplink parameters for a new transmission grant.

methods.name: get_retx_ul_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended uplink parameters for a retransmission grant.

methods.name: compute_newtx_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Selects VRBs for a new uplink transmission.

methods.name: compute_retx_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Selects VRBs for an uplink retransmission.
